classes.name: Pyromancer
classes.lore: Sets things alight and lets them burn. Piles burns onto a target, then sets them all off at once, and leaves the ground on fire behind it.
classes.passive: Burns stack up to 3 times. Each one does 4 damage at the start of its victim's turn.

opponent.name: Ashka the Kindled
lines: Stand still. It is quicker for both of us.
Embers go out. Mine just took longer than most.

classes.name: Windwalker
classes.lore: Never where you aimed. Strikes from a relay far across the board, throws enemies around, and leaves a storm where they stood.
classes.passive: Relay: an air spell that cannot reach from where you stand can be cast from your relay.

opponent.name: Sef of the Long Grass
lines: You will not see me twice in the same place.
You caught the wind. Nobody has told me how.

classes.name: Tidecaller
classes.lore: Slows the fight to a pace only one side can keep. Traps, ice and water decide where the enemy can stand, and its own water heals it.
classes.passive: Your water slows enemies by 1 MP and heals you 5 when you start a turn in it. Water puts fire out.

opponent.name: Mother Brine
lines: Come closer, child. The water is warm.
The tide turns. Even for me, it seems.

classes.name: Stonewarden
classes.lore: Slow to start and terrible up close. Leaps into reach, drags enemies in, and walls off their way out.
classes.passive: +50% damage against a target standing right next to you.

opponent.name: Old Grund
lines: Hide behind whatever you like. The rock does not mind.
Well. Mountains wear down too, I suppose.
